Possible drone near Sulina prompts warning; Romanian entry not established

12 November 2026 · Northeastern Tulcea · 12 November Sulina target warning

MApN-reported nearby air target; Romanian entry not established

Romania’s defence ministry reported an aerial target about 28 km northeast of Sulina on 12 November. Public radio described it as a possible drone.

A warning ran from 12:35 to 13:12 local, and two Spanish F-18s launched. This selected alert is not a confirmed Romanian incursion or attack.
